From: Sam Li <sam@streamline.ai>

Subject: Emergency credit need for tonight's real-time burst test

Hey Diego,

Quick one — our team at Streamline is running a late-night real-time burst validation tonight (start ~22:00 PT) to validate p95 latency under sustained 1.2k QPS for our streaming ingestion. We underestimated the token burn for the full end-to-end flow. Can you help us with a temporary credits top-up to cover a 12–24h soak?

What we need: ~150k generation tokens (estimate), concentrated between 22:00–03:00 PT. Primary goals are p95 latency <= 250ms and KV cache behavior under concurrent sessions.

Why it matters: this test is gating an internal launch next week — if we fail latency, schedule slips. We can consolidate results and send a short summary to your team.

Attachments: load-plan.csv (contains ramp schedule + traffic mix).

Appreciate any fast help,

— Sam Li
Head of Engineering, Streamline AI
[sam@streamline.ai]
